res.policy_prefix:
Welcome to 画世界Pro!
Before using, please read
res.policy_prefix2:
to understand the services we provide, how we handle personal info, and your rights.
1. To ensure safe and normal operation, we collect device info, service logs, IP address, phone number, and mutable device identifiers (Android ID, OAID, GAID). Location info is collected during sharing and one-tap login for refined operations and security checks.
2. Storage permission is requested when drawing and saving files.
3. Media, image, audio, camera, and microphone permissions are requested when importing images, changing avatars, or recording audio.
Tapping "Agree" means you accept these agreements and consent to necessary data collection/processing. Network access is required and may incur data charges from your carrier.

libre.libre_settings_subtitle: Languages, custom fonts, offline access, and canvas options
libre.libre_desc_dynamic_i18n: Replaces UI text from built-in or external JSON language files. Turn off to restore Chinese.
libre.libre_desc_custom_font: Applies .ttf or .otf fonts from HuashijiePro/fonts/ across the UI. Select System Default to restore.
libre.libre_desc_instant_launch: Skips the startup countdown and opens directly to the draft gallery. Turn off to restore the original startup screen.
libre.libre_desc_hide_community: Hides the Community and Discover tabs on the home screen, leaving local drafts only. Turn off and restart to restore.
libre.libre_desc_hide_topbar_cloud: Hides cloud sync icons on the gallery top bar and ignores taps so login prompts do not open. Turn off to restore.
libre.libre_desc_hide_draft_cloud_tick: Hides cloud sync icons and progress bars on draft thumbnails. Turn off to restore.
libre.libre_desc_optimize_create_canvas: Hides the online templates button and centers Custom Canvas, Pixel Art, and Open Image. Turn off to restore.
libre.libre_desc_touch_outside: Exits active Lasso selection with a tap outside the selection bounds without affecting Magic Wand, Polygonal Lasso, or active guides. Turn off for button exit only.
libre.libre_desc_free_ref_rotation: Enables two-finger rotation inside the floating reference window with an 8-degree anti-tilt deadzone. Turn off for pan and zoom only.
libre.libre_desc_floating_sliders: Adds a 2x2 drag handle between the brush size and opacity sliders to move them on screen. Turn off to dock them at the side.
libre.libre_desc_clean_speedpaint: Removes the corner brand watermark during timelapse playback and video export. Turn off to keep the original watermark.
libre.libre_desc_local_brush: Allows editing, renaming, and duplicating preset and imported brushes without account checks. Turn off to restore checks.
libre.libre_desc_system_share: Routes image, PSD, PDF, brush, and .hsj exports to the Android Share Sheet. Turn off for the built-in share menu.
libre.libre_desc_storage_transparency: Displays active local .hsj draft and export folder paths inside Draft Storage Settings. Turn off to hide this card.
libre.libre_desc_block_telemetry: Stops xCrash and MarsXlog logging libraries from initializing at startup. Turn off and restart to restore.
libre.libre_desc_offline_user: Supplies an in-memory local profile when signed out so login-gated local tools such as PDF export work offline without overwriting signed-in accounts. Turn off and restart to revert.
libre.libre_banner_restart_needed: Some changes take effect after restarting the app
libre.libre_desc_hide_canvas_exit_cloud: Hides cloud upload options in the canvas exit dialog while keeping local save and discard. Turn off for original options.
libre.libre_desc_hide_brush_shop: Hides the online store button in the quick brush selector while keeping all local brushes. Turn off to restore.
libre.libre_desc_enable_animations: Plays a slide animation when opening this settings screen. Turn off to open immediately.

libre.libre_desc_block_brush_upgrade_tip: Hides brush upgrade banners above the brush selector. Turn off to show again.
libre.libre_desc_hide_baidu_backup: Hides the Baidu Netdisk backup entry in the navigation drawer. Turn off and restart to show again.
libre.libre_desc_hide_personalized_ads: Hides the personalized advertisement row in General Settings. Turn off to restore.
libre.libre_desc_hide_domestic_export: Hides domestic social buttons in the image export dialog while keeping Album and File saves. Turn off to show again.
libre.libre_desc_text_auto_fit: Scales down and wraps long labels on narrow buttons and tabs to prevent clipping. Turn off for original sizing.
libre.libre_opt_export_share_button: Show Share button in export dialog
libre.libre_desc_export_share_button: Adds a System Share button next to Album and File inside the image and timelapse export dialogs. Turn off to keep local save buttons only.
libre.libre_desc_hide_canvas_popup_cloud: Hides cloud backup controls in the canvas settings popup and the cloud tab in image pickers. Turn off to show again.
libre.libre_desc_hide_drawer_vip: Hides the VIP membership banner in the navigation drawer. Turn off to show again.
libre.libre_desc_block_umeng_sdk: Disables Umeng analytics initialization and event collection. Turn off and restart to restore.
libre.libre_desc_block_bugly_sdk: Disables Tencent Bugly crash reporting initialization. Turn off and restart to restore.
libre.libre_desc_suppress_splash_ad: Stops splash ad requests and display on startup. Turn off to restore original splash ads.
libre.libre_desc_hide_timelapse_social: Hides social buttons inside the timelapse export dialog while keeping quality and local save options. Turn off to restore.
libre.libre_desc_replay_system_share: Uses the Android Share Sheet when sharing timelapse videos from the replay screen. Turn off for built-in sharing.
libre.libre_desc_hide_brush_library_shop: Hides the online store button inside the full-screen Brush Library modal. Turn off to restore.
libre.libre_desc_external_brush_import: Scans HuashijiePro/ASBrush on startup and keeps imported brush sets available offline. Turn off to stop scanning.
libre.libre_desc_canvas_hsj_path: Adds a tap-to-copy row showing the local .hsj draft folder inside the Canvas settings tab. Turn off to hide it.
libre.libre_desc_canvas_popup_polish: Adjusts spacing in canvas popups and reference windows, and adapts left tool grid columns. Turn off for original layout.
